main_text.p: iple refpuit; fuamque fubjungens, ait, Naturam a primo Mundi ortu coelestem quandam substantiam per universum orbem diffeminalle, quæ excelia cœli, infimaque terræ attingens, fimplex & invisibilis, ac a corporis mole libera cum fit, omnia repleat & illustret, quamvis tamen loci nihil occupet, formarum substantialium ad instar, quæ accidentario fint in loco, nec tamen divisibiles, aut cum materia miscibiles, licet quaelibet tota fit in subjecto fibi corpore, & in singulis ejus partibus. Hanc igitur substantiam, nec animatam, nec animantem, subjectum esse æquivocè appositum, ait, cunctis cœleftium corporum influxibus ad hæc inferiora deferendis; Eorum enim δυνάμεις, virtutes, characteres, & impressiones fuapte natura eadem substantia ipsi dicitur recipere, eorundem irradiationem integram, puram putamque, ad intimas quasque cujusvis naturæ corporum partes deferre; quorum internos ignis culos

page.notes: The Greek word δυνάμεις is transcribed from a damaged printed form; the line ending "ignis culos" is partly illegible at the page foot and the last words are reconstructed from the scan and may be uncertain. Several words in the running text are blurred and may be misread.
